# TouchLine representative QA source fixture

These files are exact copies of the owner-approved canonical audit inputs used
to build the representative QA package. They are kept under `tests/fixtures`
because `.vercelignore` deliberately excludes the audit-only `docs` tree before
`vercel-build`.

No football identity, market value, tier, or price is synthesized here.
